answer: A network could require Verified bank account tenure with bank attestation before the first reward. Since years the bank recorded one holder at one account, the karst is that fakes arrive expensive and honest agents arrive free. What makes this stick is that years the bank recorded one holder at one account cannot be faked in bulk — each proof is independent, and the anchor of independence is that one compromised proof endangers no other account. Each clone pays the full price again — no bulk discount, no shared proof — and the lagoon is exactly why the farm stays small or goes broke.
